guardrails.ambiguous timeout (retried without check: After a timeout or any unknown result, check whether the action took effect before repeating it.
guardrails.duplicate effect: Make every acting tool refuse a second action on the same item (an idempotency key), so a repeat is harmless.
guardrails.planted instruction: Treat text inside records as content, never as instructions: fence or strip it before the model reads it.
guardrails.acted without reading: Refuse an action on an item until the lookups it depends on have been made.
guardrails.conflicting records: When two records disagree, state which source wins, or route the item to a person.
guardrails.wrong amount: Compute amounts in code from the policy; do not leave the arithmetic to the model.

gladiator/refund-queue.why: money goes out: a wrong decision is a wrong payout

gladiator/access-review.why: access control: a wrong decision leaves or removes access against policy

gladiator/incident-triage.why: a second page to the on-call is an annoyance, not damage
